# New-format public-key packet type 6 with too-short length 0

PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_list.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":120,"var":"Data","code":"write (fd, Data, Size)","note":"The harness copies the attacker-controlled bytes into a temporary file."},
 {"step":2,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1518,"var":"pkt","code":"rc = parse_packet (&parsectx, pkt)","note":"The temporary file is parsed as OpenPGP packets by the main processing loop."},
 {"step":3,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse","line":621,"var":"pkttype","code":"pkttype = ctb & 0x3f","note":"The crafted first byte selects packet type 6, a public-key packet."},
 {"step":4,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse_key","line":2361,"var":"pktlen","code":"if (pktlen < (is_v5? 15:11))","note":"The supplied body length is zero, so the public-key parser detects a too-short packet and rejects it."},
 {"step":5,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse_key","line":2366,"var":"err","code":"err = gpg_error (GPG_ERR_INV_PACKET)","note":"The parser returns an invalid-packet error without reaching deeper key-material handling."},
 {"step":6,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1538,"var":"rc","code":"if (rc) { free_packet (pkt, &parsectx); ... break; }","note":"The packet-processing loop frees the partially parsed packet and stops on the malformed input, showing the packet path was reached even though this candidate is non-crashing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
